properties.name: FIELD REPORT (bhome S3, 2026-09-18): eight refusals filed as 'version skew, same diagnosis as Session 2' — MEASURED: seven of the eight argument names never existed in any release (get_instructions.scope, propagate_from.seeds, find_tools.intent, add_epoch.status, snapshot_before_change.reason, review_relations.edge_type, reconcile_verification.note) and the eighth, add_change_event.id, is required and was omitted. The second project in two days to report guessed names as schema drift

properties.statement: Reporter: 'Argument shape, six more failures to version skew … Same diagnosis as Session 2 and the same cost.' MEASURED against toolsnaps at v0.62.0 and today: none of the seven fields existed at either; `id` on add_change_event has always been required. PRECEDENT already on the record: fact:reading-the-published-schema-turned-13-constructor-refusals-into-zero — guessing refused 13 of 20 constructors, reading describe_schema refused none. flo2 F1 (2026-09-18) was the same class with the same wrong diagnosis. CAUSE, two parts: the agent guesses names by analogy instead of reading the served schema, and until 2026-09-19 the refusal text led with 'your client's tool list may predate the server', which both reporters copied into their diagnosis. The second part is fixed in the field-feedback batch (nearest served parameter first); the first is the recorded lesson that describe_schema is read before a constructor is called.
